extensionAttribute.displayName: Version of Acrobat Reader DC installed
extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed Adobe Acrobat Reader DC version, or N/A if absent.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Acrobat Reader DC Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe)
plist="/Applications/Adobe Acrobat Reader.app/Contents/Info.plist" [[ ! -f "$plist" ]] && plist="/Applications/Adobe Acrobat Reader DC.app/Contents/Info.plist"
if [[ -f "$plist" ]]; then ver=$(/usr/bin/defaults read "$plist" CFBundleShortVersionString 2>/dev/null) echo "<result>${ver:-Unknown}</result>" else echo "<result>N/A</result>" fi
